notes.title: Wraithmind Version 1.5 Released!
notes.content:
Hello Everyone!

We are excited to announce that Version 1.5 of Wraithmind is now available! This update brings major improvements, new content, and rebalanced gameplay to make the game even better. 

Here is a summary of the changes included in this new version: 

 Several new enemies have been added throughout the game to add more variety. 
 Enemy locations have been rebalanced throughout the game. In addition, some robot enemies have been relocated to the training center. 
 A mini map of the current location has been added to the main HUD. You can toggle it on and off. 
 A new map menu has been added to see the entire map of the current location. 
 The mini map and map include an indicator of where you need to go. 
 Text has been updated throughout the game to improve the story and make things more consistent. 
 A new world map has been added to connect the locations in the first half of the game. 
 Some of the story events and locations have been updated to provide a better flow to the overall game. 
 An entire new story event with multiple new locations has been added during the first half of the game. 
 New characters have been added to the new locations. 
 The talent menu has been revamped and the order in which you can learn talents has been improved. 
 A battle related effect which was not obvious now has a text indicator. 
 The final dungeon now has several new maps. 
 A few new songs have been added to the game to improve existing locations and provide variety in new ones. 

[previewyoutube=Dk-T2rHNFFE;full][/previewyoutube]
This update includes changes to a lot of systems. Although we have tested thoroughly there might be bugs that we missed. If you notice any issues while playing, please let us know so we can work on a fix as quickly as possible. 

Thank you very much to everyone who has supported this game these last several years. We hope you enjoy the new version!

notes.title: Wraithmind Version 1.4 Released!
notes.content:
Hello everyone! 

We are pleased to announce that Wraithmind Version 1.4 is now available! The new version should be available for WIndows, Mac and Linux! 

This new version includes multiple improvements and changes: 


 Enhanced camera system for improved environmental views.
 Refined existing environments to align with the upgraded camera.
 Removal of the inventory menu to streamline gameplay and resolve bugs.
 Enemy stat tweaks for a balanced progression experience.
 Backend changes laying the groundwork for future updates.

This new version should provide players with a better experience throughout the game. One of the changes mentioned above is the removal of the inventory system. We've received several reports of bugs related to this menu but we were not able to resolve them. Removing the menu altogether was the best choice for the time being since it wasn't widely used and didn't really serve it's original purpose. A new inventory menu and system might be reintroduced in a future version of the game. 

One of the biggest changes in Version 1.4 is many of the backend improvements which won't be noticeable to players yet. These improvements are laying the groundwork for future updates which are currently in development. 

Thank you for playing Wraithmind and we hope you enjoy this new version! 

TEKO Games

notes.title: Wraithmind 1.2.0 & Linux Version released!
notes.content:
Hello everyone! I have released version 1.2.0 of Wraithmind and the game is also now available for Linux! The new version of Wraithmind includes the following changes and fixes: 


 Released the official Linux version of the game
 Made many adjustments to the UI
 Made some adjustments to various text elements throughout the game
 Made some adjustments to balancing
 Fixed issues with items sometimes disappearing
 Fixed an issue where the game would sometimes crash when opening doors


Thank you to everyone that is pointed out issues with the game. I will be continuing to monitor and make adjustments as I become aware of them. Until then, happy holidays and happy new year everyone!

notes.title: Wraithmind 1.1.2 Released
notes.content:
Hello everyone! 

I have just uploaded version 1.1.2 of Wraithmind. This version fixes a few issues some users have been experiencing. 

Release Notes


 Changed the framerate of the game to a fixed value. The framerate would sometimes be too high which would cause characters to walk really slowly. Now that the value is fixed this should no longer be an issue. 
 Removed a zoom effect in Chapter 3 that would sometimes cause the game to crash.
 Fixed a few issues where selecting enemies or players would not select the correct target.

notes.title: Wraithmind Full Version Update
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

I am happy to announce that the full version of Wraithmind is now ready! I have spent the last two months finalizing the remaining chapters of the game, and it is now in a state ready for release. I will be pushing an update on Steam shortly with the full version of the game. Note: This update also includes a revamp of the progression system. 

Unfortunately, due to complex issues anyone who has a saved game in the previous version of the game will have to start a new game. I apologize for this inconvenience. 

Wraithmind will stay in Early Access for a couple more weeks as I evaluate if any issues need to be fixed. Afterwards, the game will be leaving Early Access and will be released officially! I will be announcing the official release date soon. 

Thank you to everyone that has already played the game and has given me suggestions or informed me of issues! As you play the full version of the game, please let me know what you think or if you run into any issues.

notes.title: Wraithmind Progress Update - September 2020
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

It's been almost 6 months since Wraithmind was released in Early Access. Since then, like many of you I have had to make adjustments due to the ongoing pandemic. However, this has not slowed down the development of the game. 

Chapters 2 and 3 are progressing well and I will be releasing an updated version of the game in the coming weeks. The original intention was to release chapter 2 first and then continue working on chapter 3. However, as I was working on chapter 2 I realized that it did not make sense to work on the chapters independently. Therefore, I have done a lot of progress on both chapters simultaneously. This means that the amount of time between the release of chapter 2 and 3 will be shorter than the amount of time it took between the first two chapters. 

Furthermore, as development was progressing I also did an overhaul of the progression system. In the final version of the game you will no longer increment stats of your characters. Instead, I have implemented a talent system which will allow you to change the behavior of each character's skills. This makes progression more seamless and makes your choices more meaningful. 

I will be posting another update in a few weeks as the next chapters become closer to completion.
